title: Testing Deliveries by Cargo Bike
transcript:
Three businesses in Elmford are testing a shared cargo bike for deliveries within the town centre. The bike has a large box at the front and an electric motor to help the rider on hills. A bookshop, a florist, and a small office supply company will use it for eight weeks before deciding whether to buy similar bikes of their own.

The trial is intended to reduce the time drivers spend looking for parking spaces. Although the shops are close to many of their customers, delivery vans often have to circle the same streets before they can stop legally. The bike can use designated parking areas beside the pavements, but riders must still walk it through the pedestrian shopping street.

Each shop will have the bike for a different part of the day. The florist will use it first because most of its orders need to reach customers before lunch. Larger orders and items requiring special protection will continue to travel by van. Staff have been trained to secure loads so that the weight is balanced.

A local college will help compare delivery times, costs, and customer feedback. The organisers say a successful trial would not mean replacing every van. They want to discover which journeys suit a smaller vehicle. Rainy days will be included in the records because the businesses need a service that works beyond the best weather.

questions.prompt: What problem is the delivery trial mainly intended to address?
options: A shortage of flowers in local shops.
Customers ordering items from outside town.
Time lost while van drivers look for parking.
The high cost of printing delivery receipts.
questions.answer: Time lost while van drivers look for parking.
questions.explanation: 试验主要希望减少货车司机寻找合法停车位所浪费的时间。

questions.prompt: What must riders do in the pedestrian shopping street?
options: Leave the delivery box at the entrance.
Wait until all shops have closed.
Follow a van through the street.
questions.explanation: 即使使用货运自行车，经过步行购物街时也必须下车推行。

questions.prompt: Why will the florist use the bike first each day?
options: Most of its deliveries are needed before lunch.
Its staff live closest to the bicycle store.
Its orders are always the heaviest.
Its customers pay an extra delivery fee.
questions.answer: Most of its deliveries are needed before lunch.
questions.explanation: 花店的大部分订单需要在午饭前送达，因此每天先使用自行车。

questions.prompt: What do the organisers hope to learn?
options: How to stop all van deliveries immediately.
Which types of journey are suitable for a smaller vehicle.
Whether customers will collect every order themselves.
How to avoid keeping records on rainy days.
questions.answer: Which types of journey are suitable for a smaller vehicle.
questions.explanation: 组织者希望判断哪些配送行程适合小型车辆，而非完全取代所有货车。
